article_title: Effects of a 7-Month Exercise Intervention Programme on the Psychosocial Adjustment and Decrease of Anxiety among Adolescents
citation: Irina Kliziene, Sarunas Klizas, Ginas Cizauskas, Saule Sipaviciene. (2018). Effects of a 7-month Exercise Intervention Programme on the Psychosocial Adjustment and Decrease of Anxiety Among Adolescents. European Journal of Contemporary Education, 7(1): 127-136. https://doi.org/10.13187/ejced.2018.1.127
title: 7-month modified physical education exercise intervention programme
description: A structured physical education intervention for 14–15-year-old adolescents in which the experimental group "participated in modified physical education lessons two times a week" and "Once a month they received a theory class where they were taught about communication disorders of adolescents and ways of preventing them by means of physical activities." Practical classes included sports and games (basketball, volleyball and football) as well as Pilates. The programme aimed to strengthen psychosocial adaptation-related behaviours during physical education lessons, and was evaluated against unmodified PE lessons with the Rogers and Dymond questionnaire and the RCMAS.
requirements: Delivered within twice-weekly physical education lessons by the same teacher for both groups
Includes a monthly theory class on adolescent communication disorders and their prevention through physical activities
Combines team sports and games with Pilates to enhance physical abilities
constraints: Evaluated only in 14–15-year-old non-physically active adolescents in one randomly selected Lithuanian secondary school
The control group received no treatment beyond unmodified physical education lessons
target_learners: adolescents aged 14–15 in secondary school physical education
target_learning_goals: psychosocial adjustment (self-esteem, evaluation by others, emotional comfort, internality, dominance)
reduction of somatic, personality and social anxiety
examples: Experimental-group girls and boys had basketball, volleyball, football and Pilates in practical classes, plus one theory class per month
